name: plan-claude-council
description: The Claude-only Council (0.8.3): a planning chain that runs entirely on your Claude subscription, next to the three planning chains (plan-mini-council, plan-medium-council, plan-high-council). It runs the planning stages without the alternatives stage and without the deep dive, with three proposers (Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Opus 5.5) and a layered review panel of six named judges in three layers: layer 1 Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5; layer 2 Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Opus 5.5; layer 3 Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable 5.1. Every proposer, every judge and the writer are Claude models from one company, Anthropic: this chain does not give the independence of judges from different companies that the other chains are built for. Sonnet 5.5 sits in layers 1 and 2 and Opus 5.5 in layers 2 and 3 as separate seats, each answered in its own fresh session, so the two see neither each other's reasoning nor the session that wrote the plan; nothing in the harness checks that the sessions were separate. Every layer has at least two judges. A layer is asked only when every layer below it signed off, and a layer signs off when all its judges do. Any objection at a lower layer sends the draft to the reviser and the climb starts again at layer 1; a round ends only when layer 3 gives its verdict, a sign-off or an objection. This chain allows 2 such overseer rounds (maxOverseerRounds) and, inside one round, 1 revision of layer 1 and 1 of layer 2 (layerRevisions). When either limit is reached the run stops, resumable and NOT agreed, and you choose: continue (you type a new spending limit), or finish (the dispute stage and the handoff run and the result stays "not agreed"), or revise the draft yourself. Every seat is external (provider external): each one pauses the run (exit 3) until it is answered, so a run stops for every proposal, debate post, reply and verdict, up to 24 judge answers at the limits. A Claude Code session can answer the stops one by one with the external_prompt and submit_stage tools, starting a fresh sub-agent on each seat's model for each answer. The reasoning effort of a seat is whatever its session runs at; set it to high. answer_back is on: a judge's own earlier objection is shown back to it, and only that judge can close it. The criteria, skeleton, build, revise and handoff stages need a Claude Code session (provider external): they pause the run (exit 3) until the session answers. No Grok, no Kimi. Dry run (0.8.3, the dry run's assumed sizes): $0.00 expected and an upper estimate of $0.00 in API cost: every call is answered through your Claude subscription and uses your plan's usage instead of money. This roster has not run, and none of its mechanisms has been measured.
summary: Six Claude judges in three layers, all on your Claude subscription: one company, separate sessions.
